data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ata' meaning 'to return', 'Ateeyah' signifies 'Mother of Reality'. This beautiful name is mentioned in the Hadith as the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for her truthfulness and sincerity. The name Ateeyah carries the meaning “Mother of Reality” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ateeyah usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of reality and live with faith, good character and purpose.
